metadata.survey_title: Recursive Self-Improvement in AI: A Survey
metadata.count_note: Section 2.2 states 404 distinct works, but the supplied v1 PDF contains numbered entries 1–405. This archive preserves all 405 entries and their original numbers; no duplicate source identifiers were found.
metadata.verification_note: All source URLs exactly match hyperlink annotations embedded in the supplied PDF. Bibliographic details are imported from the survey; this archive is not an independent metadata audit, full-text review, or claim that every included work demonstrates RSI.
metadata.normalization_note: Page furniture and wrapping removed, URL line breaks repaired, clear line-end word hyphenation repaired, and three mathematical superscripts restored in title fields. raw_pdf_text preserves the extracted entry text.
